item.description: My research aims to uncover hidden semantic relationships between data to improve information retrieval. I combine lexical (sparse) and semantic (dense) retrieval with graph-based models for tasks such as link prediction, data annotation and table search in data lakes. Applications include retrieval-augmented generation (RAG and GraphRAG), with a particular focus on grounding generated answers in verifiable sources. I am an Associate Professor of Computer Science at Paris Nanterre University, where I teach data science in the Mathematics and Computer Science department, and a researcher in the Database Research Team at LIP6, Sorbonne University.
